nodes.html: What is the difference between a bookkeeper and a tax accountant?
nodes.text: What is the difference between a bookkeeper and a tax accountant?

nodes.html: A bookkeeper handles the day-to-day recording of transactions — invoices, bills, bank reconciliation, payroll, and BAS preparation. A tax accountant takes those records and lodges returns, gives structural advice, and manages ATO strategy. Many businesses need both. Our matching service identifies which you need — or whether a single firm that offers both is the best fit — based on what you tell us in the questionnaire.

nodes.q: Will my bookkeeper use the software I already have?
nodes.a: Yes. We match you with a bookkeeper experienced in your existing platform — Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB, Reckon, or others. There is no need to migrate or re-train your team. If you want to switch software, the matched bookkeeper can also help with that, but it is never forced.
nodes.aText: Yes. We match you with a bookkeeper experienced in your existing platform — Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB, Reckon, or others. There is no need to migrate or re-train your team. If you want to switch software, the matched bookkeeper can also help with that, but it is never forced.

nodes.q: Can a bookkeeper lodge my BAS?
nodes.a: Yes — a registered BAS Agent can prepare and lodge your Business Activity Statement. Our matched bookkeepers are registered BAS Agents where required, and their TPB registration is verified before they join the network.
nodes.aText: Yes — a registered BAS Agent can prepare and lodge your Business Activity Statement. Our matched bookkeepers are registered BAS Agents where required, and their TPB registration is verified before they join the network.

nodes.q: How much does a bookkeeper cost?
nodes.a: Bookkeeping fees vary by location, complexity, and software. As a guide, small businesses typically spend $400–$1,200 per month for ongoing bookkeeping, though catch-up work or payroll-heavy businesses can be more. The matched bookkeeper will give you a clear quote after reviewing your needs — the matching service itself is free.

nodes.q: What if I'm months behind on my books?
nodes.a: That is one of the most common reasons people use our matching. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need catch-up bookkeeping and we will connect you with a bookkeeper who specialises in bringing overdue books current — even multiple years behind.

nodes.q: Can a bookkeeper handle my payroll and STP2?
nodes.a: Yes. Many bookkeepers in our network process payroll and manage Single Touch Payroll (STP2) reporting. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need payroll support and we will match you with a bookkeeper who offers that service.
nodes.aText: Yes. Many bookkeepers in our network process payroll and manage Single Touch Payroll (STP2) reporting. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need payroll support and we will match you with a bookkeeper who offers that service.

nodes.a: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched bookkeeper will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.
